gap_details.2011-2012: RECONSTRUCTED, significance LOW. No 2011-12 roster exists in any archive: the old uihealthcare.com current.html stayed frozen at the Jan-2011 list (Wayback Jul 2011, CC-MAIN-2012 May 2012), and the UIHC GME neurosurgery pages (ids 236xxx) did not exist yet (GME page ids were ~228k in Jan 2012; first capture Nov 2012; CC-MAIN-2012 has no org,uihealthcare)/gme/ records). Reconstructed 10 bracketed residents (R2-R6). Why low: every 2010-11 R1-R5 reappears in 2012-13 at the expected PGY; the 2011 class (Abode-Iyamah, Smietana) fills the complement of 2 and both are seen in 2012-13; the 2011-12 R7 fellow associates (Dahdaleh, Vogel, Lindley) are 2011 alumni. Only an above-complement 2011 intern who left within a year could be hidden.
gap_details.2013-2014: OBSERVED in phase 2: Common Crawl CC-MAIN-2013-48 (2013-12-07) of www.uihealthcare.org/GME/InsidePages.aspx?id=236125&taxid=226497 (the InsidePages variant of the ResProgInsidePages URL that phase 1 searched); identical in CC-MAIN-2013-48 (12-13), 2014-10 (Mar 2014) and 2014-15 (Apr 2014). Complete, 14 residents, 2 per class; Smietana R3.

Complete, 14 residents. Smietana absent from 2014-07-25 on. Liesl Close absent 2014-07-25..2014-11-01 and first listed under R1 on 2014-11-23: mid-year joiner.

departures.name: Janel Smietana
departures.note: 2011 entrant; listed R3 through Apr 2014 (CC-MAIN-2014-15), absent from Jul 2014 (CC-MAIN-2014-23) on; not on the alumni page. Left at the end of 2013-14. Destination unknown (NPPES shows a NY psychiatry taxonomy, not used as evidence). training_history th_id 3100, departure_type unknown.

departures.name: William Haselden
departures.note: 2023 entrant; absent Sep 2025 and live. 2026 papers (received Nov 2025) list him in the Department of Neurology, University of Iowa Health Care, but he is not on the Iowa neurology residency directory; role unknown. training_history th_id 3101, departure_type unknown.

joiners.name: Liesl Close
joiners.note: Added to the R1 list mid-year (between the 2014-11-01 and 2014-11-23 captures); 3rd member of the 2014 class. Then R2 2015-16, R4 2017-18, R5 2018-19, PGY-7 2019-20 (one year ahead), graduated 2020. Probably credited prior training: NPPES shows a 2012 NPI with an Arizona surgery resident license (NPPES only, not confirmed). training_history th_id 3102.

adjudication_summary.note: The 3 'outcome unknown' (Dahdaleh, Vogel, Lindley; 2005 entrants) are 2011 graduates on the alumni page (before the 2012 cut-off), not attrition. Real departures: Smietana (end of 2013-14, after PGY-3) and Haselden (summer 2025, after PGY-2). 2011+ entrants: 34.

problems: Common Crawl index range requests failed (cluster.idx) for CC-MAIN-2015-35 and CC-MAIN-2017-30 (uihealthcare.com prefix, irrelevant old host), CC-MAIN-2018-13 and CC-MAIN-2019-09 (gme.medicine.uiowa.edu/neurological-surgery-residency) and CC-MAIN-2020-24 (uihealthcare.org id=236125); only the 2018-13/2019-09 ones could matter and both fall inside the observed 2017-18/2018-19 years. Alumni-year conventions shift: through the 2012 entrants 'graduation' = end of chief R6 (R7 was a 'Fellow Associate' year), from the 2013 entrants it is end of PGY-7; no 2019 graduates exist because of that switch. Andrew Grossbach: live alumni page says 2017, the 2022 archived alumni page says 2016 (inserted 2017, both noted). Liesl Close (2014 entrant) was listed PGY-7 in 2019-20, one year ahead of her classmates, and graduated 2020 (accelerated, not a departure). PHASE 2: Phase-1 Common Crawl failures (2015-35, 2017-30 uihealthcare.com; 2018-13, 2019-09 gme; 2020-24 uihealthcare.org) were retried in phase 2 and all succeeded. They held no new roster (only a Mar-2018 gme current-residents record inside observed 2017-18). The phase-2 CC passes (2012, 2013-2016) had no failures.

terminal_pgy_note: Through the 2012 entrants, 'graduation' on the alumni page is the end of the chief year (R6); R7 was a post-graduation 'Fellow Associate' year. From the 2013 entrants graduation is the end of PGY-7. Hence no 2019 graduates.
